notes: Positions only: where in the program ROM the palette of each sprite frame (its sprite_frame, the record's offset in sprite_frame_records) starts; tools/palette_census.py writes it.

'drawn': the palette the sprite frame (its sprite_frame, the record's offset in sprite_frame_records) was shown with in the scenarios; 'nearby': one no scenario shows, given the palette of the sprite frame (its sprite_frame, the record's offset in sprite_frame_records) before it.
